pr117_disposition.accepted_as: Fail-closed RGB24 count; ordinary vs standalone pixels; run-dir immutability; decode-only verification of four saved streams.
pr117_disposition.not_accepted_as: New RD evidence, BD-rate, or confirmation scoring authorization.

native_pts_limitation_retained.cause: 24 fps extract vs native seek; nearest packet-DTS is not pixel provenance.

decision_and_hypothesis: On the saved display_low Federer scene 007 stack, with generation off and a reused E04A panorama-QP47 background, residual-on should raise whole-frame PSNR versus the paired residual-off predictor (per_frame_crop or bbox_resized_first_reference) by at least 0.5 dB while charging T = B+F+M+R+H. Competing explanations: residual is a no-op on these predictors; F+M already exhaust A(q) so residual cannot win on total rate; bbox resize of one crop matches per-frame crops on this window. These names are not optical flow, per-object pose warp, or the E05 first-reference paste control.
question: Does residual pay for itself on standalone per-frame-crop and bbox-resized-first-reference controls at this operating point, versus saved AV1/VVC anchors, without a neural predictor?

e04a_background.why_this_arm: Only saved removal-off arm with vis PSNR above 21 dB and B+side under 5 kB. Not a panorama winner claim.

evidence_reused.gap: No charged full-wire paste or warped-reference rows exist on this stack. E04A omits F. Wave-2 residual ladders are 4K, generation-intent broken, and uncompressed-mask dominated.

operating_regime.native_pts_policy: Keep the E03B mapping. Do not relabel 24 fps extract indices as native frames.

predictors.per_frame_crop: Per occupied frame, WebP-code that frame's bbox crop and composite it. Former informal name paste; not E05 first-reference paste.
predictors.bbox_resized_first_reference: WebP-code one reference crop (first occupied frame) and composite it into every later union bbox by resize; charge one F payload plus per-frame masks/bboxes. Former informal name warped-reference; not optical flow or pose warp.

smallest_discriminating_probe.background_fixed: E04A registered_panorama VVC qp47 bitstream plus its serialized homographies
smallest_discriminating_probe.standalone: Client reconstructs from serialized B, F, masks/pose/headers, residual stream, and container. No source pixels. Fail closed on short/partial/extra RGB dumps once #117 is merged.
smallest_discriminating_probe.ledger: T = B + F + M + R + H with each byte once. B=panorama, F=actor_reference, M=mask_payload+pose_motion+placement_headers+envelope, R=residual, H=container remainder inside transport_total. Residual-off requires R=0 and zero residual codec calls. Reject raw_parts as a rate.
smallest_discriminating_probe.pose: Charge pose_motion when keypoints are serialized. This first card records pose_present=false if the E04A union-mask path has no skeleton payload; do not invent pose bytes.
controls: reuse hash of prepared stack and pinned B bitstream before any encode
paste vs bbox-resized first reference: the latter uses exactly one appearance payload
calibrate on the saved E03B grid (do not rescore confirmation sources)
quote VMAF beside identical 97.93 / unrelated 1.38 / severe-blur 0.0

whole_frame_psnr_y_db.cite_floor: severe-blur on this grid 17.73 dB; VVC QP63 17.93 dB

vmaf.note: Include 0; E03B [5,100] was too tight on this grid.

quality_floors.matched_quality_for_A_q: Use E03B AV1 QP63 (19116 B, 27.4 dB) and VVC QP47 (21288 B, 24.6 dB) as the rate neighbours. Do not BD-rate. A point is only compared to an anchor within 0.5 dB PSNR-Y.
quality_floors.component_reject: If residual-off T - R already exceeds A(q) at every overlapping q, residual cannot win that q even if free.

size_bytes_T.basis: Uncompressed 360p 48f 4:2:0 plus container slack; tool-floor >1 kB.

psnr_y_db.basis: Colour/decode mismatch below 15; mild residual ceiling below 50.

encode_plus_decode_s_per_setting.basis: E03B four conventional encodes 92 s; E04A background arms seconds. Stop if one setting exceeds 7 minutes.

bounds_and_instrument.null: unrelated reconstruction must not outrank the decode on PSNR/SSIM/VMAF

decision_rule.promote: On at least one predictor, residual-on PSNR-Y is >= residual-off + 0.5 dB, R>0, ledger reconciles, standalone pixels match, and T is reported with all parts. Then cost a two-QP residual refinement only if that arm also sits within 0.5 dB of an E03B neighbour.
decision_rule.stop: Residual-on quality <= residual-off (ineffective option); raw_parts nonempty; decode-count failure; prepared/B hash mismatch; overwrite of a completed run dir.
decision_rule.inconclusive: No 0.5 dB overlap with any saved E03B point: report T and quality, do not BD-rate, do not claim a codec win.

budget.control_budget_share: at least one third for decode, calibration reuse, scoring, ledger
budget.estimated_from_prior: E03B 92 s encode wall for four conventional settings; E04A six background arms minutes. Four 360p PointStream residual/appearance encodes expected well under 15 minutes; return if one setting exceeds 7 minutes.
budget.if_exceeded: Stop after the first predictor pair that finishes; do not add residual QPs.

implementation_gaps_before_launch: Serialized transport, T=B+F+M+R+H ledger, honest predictor names, standalone/ordinary pixel equality, and immutable reuse hashes must pass CI on this revision.
Launch only after this revision is merged with green CI. No conventional or background re-encodes.

artifact_and_narrative.plot: T versus whole-frame PSNR-Y for four PointStream points and four reused anchors; residual-off/on joined per predictor; encode/client seconds beside each point.
artifact_and_narrative.supported_sentence: Residual-on improved per_frame_crop (or bbox_resized_first_reference) by >=0.5 dB at measured extra R bytes on this development window.
artifact_and_narrative.contradicted_sentence: Residual-on did not improve the unaided reconstruction, or F+M already exceeded A(q).
artifact_and_narrative.scope: One 4 s development scene at 360p/12 fps. Not a Gate A/B pass.
